title: Stickman Battle
author: Delicious-Editor-168
selftext:
Game Title: Stickman Battle

Playable Link: [https://arrows-dev.itch.io/stickman-battle](https://arrows-dev.itch.io/stickman-battle)

Platform: \[PC\] (Web)

Description: Stickman Battle is an arcade-style real-time coding combat game that runs directly in your web browser with zero installation or sign-up needed. Instead of controlling your character using traditional arcade buttons or WASD keys, you write custom combat logic in Python to outsmart and outplay your opponent in a fast-paced 60 FPS physics arena. The game features seven unique autonomous AI opponents ranging from an immortal peaceful practice dummy to relentless grandmaster bosses calibrated with realistic human decision delays. You can duel friends in private 1v1 multiplayer lobbies with shareable room codes or test your algorithms solo. The battle engine includes trigonometric projectile spellcasting where sine and cosine waves collide in mid-air to create destructive shockwaves, along with real-time tactical sensors for proximity, shields, crouching, and energy management. I would love to hear your feedback on the pacing, AI difficulty, and combat feel!

Free to Play Status:

\* \[ \] Free to play

\* \[ \] Demo/Key available

\* \[ \] Paid (Allowed only on Tuesdays with \[TT\] in the title)

Involvement: Solo developer. I built the entire game from scratch including the 60 FPS physics engine, Python AST execution sandbox, real-time WebSocket networking, and procedural audio synthesis.
